name: ClinArbor
tagline: Multi-clinic system for US outpatient clinics: patient records, appointments, charting and billing.
features: Patient records with field-level encryption of sensitive data
Appointment scheduling and provider availability
Clinical charting (visit notes)
Billing, invoices and payments
Patient portal
pricing: Per staff seat per month (sample prices): Starter $49 (1 location, up to 5 seats), Practice $89 (up to 3 locations, adds prescribing, superbills, reports and the staff app), Group $129 (everything, including the patient portal and API). 14-day free trial (30 days on Group). Shown at https://careloop-demo.onrender.com/pricing once deployed.
notes: Synthetic patients only. The free hosting has no HIPAA agreement, so real patient data must never go on the demo.

name: StaffCairn
tagline: HR system for 20–500 person companies (renamed from PeopleDesk, which is another company's product). One employment record drives the org chart, time, leave and pay.

accounts.role: Team lead: approvals inbox, team goals, 1:1s

features: Departments, positions, reporting lines and headcount plan
Employee records with full history, documents and dependants
Time & attendance: shifts, clock in/out, overtime rules
Leave: accrual policies, balances, holiday calendars, approvals
Multi-step approval engine reused by every workflow
Salary history, pay runs (gross pay) and payroll CSV export
Employee phone app (Expo): clock in/out, leave requests and approvals, payslips, directory
Expense claims and reimbursement
Onboarding / offboarding checklists
Performance: goals, review cycles with calibration, 1:1 notes
Users, roles and permissions, CSV import, audit log
pricing: Per employee per month: Starter $3, Growth $6 (adds Performance), 20-employee minimum. Shown at https://peopledesk-demo.onrender.com/pricing.

name: GymWren
tagline: Memberships, recurring billing and class scheduling for independent gyms and boutique studios.
features: Membership plans, trials, freezes and cancellations
Recurring billing with retries, grace periods and proration
Point of sale for drop-ins, merchandise, supplements and day passes
Class timetable with capacity and waitlists
QR / PIN check-in and attendance tracking
Personal-trainer booking and session packs
Lead capture and trial-to-member pipeline
Retention analytics: at-risk members by attendance drop
pricing: - Starter (up to 300 members): $99/month - Growth (up to 1,000 members): $199/month - Pro (unlimited members): $349/month - Optional payment-processing margin. Multi-site is the upgrade trigger.

name: SlateOne
tagline: Admissions, attendance, exams and fee collection for K–12 private schools.
features: Admissions: enquiries, applications, entrance tests, enrolment
Student records, guardians, documents and transfers
Classes, sections, subjects and teacher allocation
Daily and period-wise attendance with parent alerts
Timetable with conflict detection
Fees: schedules, invoices, receipts, discounts, arrears
Exams, grading and report cards
Announcements by section
pricing: Per student per year, banded, billed annually in advance.

name: LessonMoor
tagline: Course delivery, quizzes and certificates for training companies and independent educators (renamed from CourseKit, which collides with Google's Course Kit; the demo address and logins keep `coursekit`).
features: Public landing and pricing pages, school signup, learner self-registration, invites, password reset
Course builder: every lesson type (text, PDF, link, video with captions), reorder, prerequisites, drip release
Video upload with resume position and signed playback
Manual, self-serve and bulk enrolment with progress tracking
Quizzes, question bank, grading and pass marks
Certificates with a public verification page and printable certificate
Cohorts with deadlines and a compliance report
Discussions with moderation, notifications
Checkout, coupons, bundles, subscriptions, invoices and credit notes
Course analytics: funnel, drop-off, quiz item analysis
Learner phone app (Expo): courses, lessons, quizzes, certificates
Corporate seat pools and manager reporting
notes: The demo uses text-and-link lessons only (no video on free hosting).

name: Binwright
tagline: Multi-warehouse stock control on a tamper-proof movement ledger, with offline barcode scanning.
features: Items, variants, units of measure and barcodes
Warehouses, zones and bins
Stock movement ledger: receipts, issues, transfers, adjustments
Suppliers and purchase orders
Goods receiving with partials and discrepancies
Sales orders, picking, packing and dispatch
Cycle counts and full stocktake
Reorder points and suggested purchase orders
FIFO / average costing and stock ageing reports
pricing: Tiered by SKU count and warehouse count, plus per-scanner-device seats.

name: Passwell
tagline: Point of sale, kitchen display and recipe-level stock for independent restaurants and small chains.

Table ordering with courses, holds, transfers and voids
Kitchen display with station routing
Split bills, tips, cash and card payments
Shift close, cash counts and Z-report
Recipe cards with per-sale stock depletion
Sales reporting by hour, item and server
pricing: Per outlet per month with device bands, plus optional payment-processing margin.

name: Keyfold

features: Room types, rate plans and seasons
Date-range availability, holds and group blocks
Reservations, deposits and cancellation policies
Check-in, room assignment, walk-ins and check-out
Guest folios, taxes, splits and invoices
Night audit and daily reports
Housekeeping room status and assignments
Occupancy, ADR and RevPAR reporting

name: PipeCore

Multiple pipelines, stages, deal values and probabilities
Calls, meetings, tasks, notes and timeline
CSV import with dedupe
Quotes with line items and discount rules
Forecasting against targets
Web forms and lead routing
Conversion and activity reporting

name: Sumwright

Journal entries, reversals and period close
Quotes, invoices, recurring invoices, credit notes
Receipts and payment allocation
Bills, expenses and payment runs
Tax rulepacks and returns
Bank statement import and reconciliation
Trial balance, P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, ageing
Multi-currency

Leases, rent schedules, renewals and deposits
Rent invoicing, receipts and late fees
Arrears reminders, notices and payment plans
Maintenance requests, work orders and vendors
Owner statements and disbursements
Inspections with condition reports
Vacancy tracking

name: ChairTime

Appointments with multi-service visits
Public online booking with deposits
Card on file, cancellation windows and no-show fees
Client history, notes, allergies and consent forms
Retail checkout, tips, gift cards and packages
Staff commission reports

Proof of delivery

Fuel logs, tolls and expenses
Maintenance schedules and defects
Cost per km, per trip and per customer
